_description: MPS1-TF-CNG calibration constants for VentCon2 settings.json
_note: Copy these values into the VentCon2 web UI sensor calibration fields, or merge into data/settings.json

sensor_calibration._comment_min_pressure: Output is valid from 0 bar; specified accuracy starts at 0.5 bar
sensor_calibration._comment_max_pressure: Rated pressure PN = 16 bar; max overpressure = 32 bar

setpoint_limits._comment: Setpoint slider range matches sensor range

ratiometric_correction._note: For best accuracy, measure actual Us and scale: p_corrected = p_measured * (5.0 / Us_actual)
